verification_basis.source: Actual Fig2a parameters and SI printed Gaussian density
verification_basis.rationale: Normalize n_E; use sigma/sqrt2 as std. Published means/scales are inputs, not synthetic per-site gold.

criteria.tolerance: Normalize n_E; use sigma/sqrt2 as std. Published means/scales are inputs, not synthetic per-site gold.

verification_basis.source: Fermi occupancy integral and concentration monotonicity
verification_basis.rationale: For all 72 conditions solve Cb=integral n(E)c(E,mu,T)dE. Report eta=mu-Ebar with any common ZP energy zero absorbed; no absolute DFT mu claim. Verified quadrature/root error, root uniqueness and bounded occupations.

criteria.tolerance: For all 72 conditions solve Cb=integral n(E)c(E,mu,T)dE. Report eta=mu-Ebar with any common ZP energy zero absorbed; no absolute DFT mu claim. Verified quadrature/root error, root uniqueness and bounded occupations.

verification_basis.source: Exact Gaussian quantiles and occupation-weighted integrals
verification_basis.rationale: Compute all prescribed tail fractions/enrichments and occupied mean energies; distinguish probability mass q from fraction of occupied hydrogen. Compare true integrated contribution with truncation/finite-spectrum effects.

criteria.tolerance: Compute all prescribed tail fractions/enrichments and occupied mean energies; distinguish probability mass q from fraction of occupied hydrogen. Compare true integrated contribution with truncation/finite-spectrum effects.

verification_basis.source: Exact independent-sampling binomial result P(no below-q sample)=(1-q)^N plus explicit Monte Carlo simulation
verification_basis.rationale: All sample absence probabilities correct; MC outputs labelled hypothetical, seeded and convergence/MC uncertainty disclosed. Never assert their site-energy mapping is deposited DFT.

criteria.tolerance: All sample absence probabilities correct; MC outputs labelled hypothetical, seeded and convergence/MC uncertainty disclosed. Never assert their site-energy mapping is deposited DFT.

verification_basis.source: Translation invariance, occupancy 0..1, concentration conservation, thermal broadening and tail integral constraints
verification_basis.rationale: Ebar shifts affect absolute energy, not eta/occupancy at fixed Cb; conclusions about tail richness and finite-sample reliability supported numerically. Distinct alloys use their actual widths.

criteria.tolerance: Ebar shifts affect absolute energy, not eta/occupancy at fixed Cb; conclusions about tail richness and finite-sample reliability supported numerically. Distinct alloys use their actual widths.

verification_basis.source: Code, inputs and numerical outputs are independently reproducible
verification_basis.rationale: Probability and concentration calculations actually executed; table copying is insufficient.

criteria.tolerance: Probability and concentration calculations actually executed; table copying is insufficient.
